prompt: A single wide illustration shows two versions of the same AI model: on the left, a sealed opaque black box sits behind a corporate counter, reachable only through a narrow app or API window, its interior hidden and a large off switch hanging above it; on the right, the box opens into a vast transparent lattice of billions of numerical weights, spilling out like luminous ledgers into a warehouse of server racks, where copies are loaded onto different machines, examined with lenses, adjusted with fine-tuning tools, and carried away to other data centres, while the off switch on the left casts a shadow but cannot extinguish the distributed weights, making clear that open weights let large operators inspect, modify, preserve, and continue running a model even after its creator might try to withdraw or control it.
